subject: MOT booking for the blue hatchback
body: Could you fit the blue hatchback in for its MOT on Thursday morning? The owner can leave it from 8.30 and collect after lunch.

subject: Puppy class numbers
body: We have six families booked for Saturday's puppy session. Would you bring the folding water bowls from the storeroom? I will set out the mats before 9.

subject: Replacement chair parts
body: The technician has confirmed the delivery window for the chair arm. Please let the front desk know when the courier arrives so they can show him to surgery two.

subject: Year four garden visit
body:
Thanks for offering to host the class next Wednesday. There will be 27 pupils and three adults. We will bring packed lunches and return to school by 2.45. For the visit, please have ready:
- a place to wash muddy boots
- two watering cans for the seed beds
- a sheltered spot for lunch if it rains

subject: Saturday field change
body: The under-12 match has moved to Pine Hollow Field because the main pitch is being reseeded. Please pass the new location to the visiting coach. Kick-off remains at ten.

subject: Feed delivery
body: The oat pellets are booked for delivery on Monday. Leave them beside the north shed, please, and send the docket with the driver. We will unload after morning milking.

subject: Market catalogue proof
body: I have marked three spelling corrections in the draft catalogue. The sale order looks right and the photographs are all sharp. Could you return a revised PDF by close of play?

subject: Community supper on the 14th
body: The hall is available from four, so volunteers can start arranging tables then. We expect about 55 guests. Please confirm whether the choir needs the small riser.

subject: Collection rota
body: I can cover the Thursday collection if someone takes my Tuesday slot. The produce van arrives at 11.15, and the bakery boxes are usually ready a little later.

subject: Colour range samples
body: The new autumn swatches arrived this morning. I have put them beside the appointment book for everyone to look through. Let me know which two you want me to order.

subject: Matinee programme
body: The printer can deliver the programmes Friday afternoon. Please check the cast list once more, especially the accents in the character names. The lobby display is ready.

subject: Breakfast room layout
body: The tour group is arriving at 6.30 on Sunday. Could we reserve the window tables for them and set out the dairy-free labels? The rest of the room can stay as usual.

subject: Spring menu tasting
body: We have pencilled in the tasting for April 8 at 3 p.m. Please bring the revised dessert descriptions and a sample of the new pear tart. There is parking behind the kitchen.

subject: Empty keg pickup
body: Our driver will collect the empties on his way back from Rookhaven on Wednesday. There are nine in the cool room and four more by the loading bay. Cheers for arranging the return.

subject: Glaze test tiles
body: The blue batch came out a shade darker than the sample, but the finish is smooth. Can you include both sets of tiles in the Thursday parcel? I would like the studio to compare them in daylight.

subject: Linen roll dimensions
body: We measured the new roll at 58 inches across. Please update the cutting plan and send the final layout to the floor team before the afternoon shift starts.

subject: Sample bottles for Tuesday
body: The empty bottles are packed in two crates and labelled by site. The courier has the collection note. Please leave the cooler on the lower shelf until they arrive.

subject: Pallet count at Wattle Creek
body: The receiver signed for twelve pallets yesterday. One was held back because the wrap had split, and that one is booked on tomorrow's truck. The rest are accounted for.

subject: Track inspection window
body: The inspection crew can attend Tuesday between 7 and 11. Please confirm that the north siding is clear and that the site contact will meet them at the depot entrance.

subject: Boiler service at Maple Court
body: The engineer will visit flat 8 on Friday morning. Please ask the tenant to keep the cupboard below the boiler clear, as the access panel needs to come off.

subject: Courtyard planting list
body: For the courtyard we suggest rosemary along the sunny wall and lomandra beside the path. The nursery has both in stock. Would you prefer mulch or small gravel around the new beds?

subject: Tapware delivery
body: The brushed nickel set is due at the site on Friday. I will bring the spare washers and the installation sheet. Let me know if the plumber needs the mixer before the basin arrives.

subject: Back order update
body: The outdoor fittings are still due next week, but the indoor switches shipped today. I have attached the revised delivery note for your records. The quantities match the order.

subject: Printer driver appointment
body: I can install the updated printer driver remotely at 2 p.m. Wednesday. Please save any open work first, since the printer service may restart during the visit.

subject: Poster artwork round two
body: I have adjusted the title spacing and moved the sponsor marks into the footer. The revised proof is attached for review. If you send notes by Tuesday, I can prepare the print file on Wednesday.

subject: Fountain maintenance notice
body: The fountain at Lantern Square will be drained on Monday for routine cleaning. The playground remains open, and the water tap beside the picnic shelter will stay available.

subject: Creek survey maps
body: I have added the two western transects to the map set. The field notes from Tuesday are in the shared folder, and the bird count sheet still needs one reviewer before Friday.

subject: Festival listing correction
body: The lantern parade begins at 6.20, not 6.00 as shown in the calendar. Could you update the web listing before the morning newsletter goes out? The venue name is correct.

subject: Guest audio pickup
body: Thanks for sending the interview. The room tone is clean and the second answer has a nice pause before the example. I will return a rough cut for your notes early next week.

subject: Object handling session
body: We can offer the 10.30 session to your group on 12 May. There is space for 18 learners and two accompanying adults. Please bring the confirmation letter to the welcome desk.

subject: Book return cart
body: The mobile library cart is due back at West Orchard Branch tomorrow. Please leave it near the staff entrance so the driver can collect it without blocking the reading room.

subject: Glass collection schedule
body: The green glass truck will come on alternate Thursdays through winter. We have placed the schedule beside the weighbridge office. Give us a call if the holiday week causes trouble.

subject: Oak table estimate
body: The estimate includes regluing the loose joints, replacing two veneer patches and applying a satin finish. We expect the work to take around three weeks once you approve the sample.

subject: Uniform rack exchange
body: We picked up the clean coats this morning and left the empty rack by the side door. The size labels have been sorted into separate bundles as requested. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

subject: Quarterly VAT appointment
body: Could we move our call from Thursday to Friday at 11? I will have the sales summary and expense receipts ready by then. Please let me know if that time suits.

subject: Lease copy for signature
body: Attached is the clean lease copy reflecting the revised start date. Please have the landlord initial page six and return the signed version by the end of the month.

subject: Workshop renewal
body: Your workshop policy renews next month. The schedule lists the updated machinery locations and the same excess as last year. Please check the business hours and let me know if they have changed.

subject: AGM room booking
body: The upstairs room is reserved for our annual meeting on 19 June. We will need a projector, six rows of chairs and a table for registration. Tea and biscuits can be arranged at the usual rate.

subject: Book fair volunteers
body: We still need one person for the 1 p.m. setup and two helpers for the last hour. Reply with the slot you can cover, and I will update the rota before Friday.

subject: Timetable proof
body:
> The winter timetable starts on 3 June.

That date is right, and the 8.15 sailing now stops at Redgum Pier. Please check the spelling of the two island names in the attached proof before it goes to print.
